title: The Norton Anthology of English Literature, Vol. F: The Twentieth and Twenty-First Centuries, 11th edn
author_or_editor: Stephen Greenblatt (gen. ed.), Jahan Ramazani and Jon Stallworthy (vol. eds.)
reliability_notes: Confirmed via Norton catalogue and library records. Volume F covers 1900 to the present; the modernist and interwar sections are the backbone of this installment's verse canon.

title: The Norton Anthology of American Literature, Vol. D: 1914–1945, 10th edn
reliability_notes: Confirmed via Norton catalogue. Volume D covers American modernism, the Harlem Renaissance and the Depression; used for the American strand.

title: The Oxford Dictionary of National Biography, 60 vols
author_or_editor: H. C. G. Matthew and Brian Harrison (eds.)
reliability_notes: The standard authority for British and Irish biography; birth, death and career dates for the British, Irish and Scottish authors in this installment are checked against it.

title: The Cambridge Companion to Modernism, 2nd edn
reliability_notes: Standard critical survey of the modernist movements; used for movement definitions and dating.

title: The Cambridge Companion to the Literature of the First World War
reliability_notes: Standard critical account of First World War writing; used for the trench-poetry and war-memoir movements.

title: The Cambridge History of Twentieth-Century English Literature
reliability_notes: Period-wide literary history; used as a control on the periodisation and the movement boundaries of this installment.

title: The Oxford Companion to Twentieth-Century Literature in English
reliability_notes: Author-level reference for dates, first publications and canonical standing.

title: The Columbia Literary History of the United States
reliability_notes: The standard large-scale history of American literature; used for the American movements and for the dating of first publications.

title: The Cambridge Companion to the Harlem Renaissance
reliability_notes: Standard account of the Harlem Renaissance; used for the movement's institutions, dates and personnel.

title: The Oxford Companion to Irish Literature
reliability_notes: Author-level reference for the Irish revival and for the Dublin and Abbey Theatre writers.

title: The Cambridge Companion to the Irish Novel
reliability_notes: Used for the Irish short story and for the dating of Joyce, O'Casey and the revival dramatists.

title: The Cambridge Companion to Scottish Literature
reliability_notes: Used for the Scottish Renaissance and for MacDiarmid and Gibbon.

title: The Oxford Companion to English Literature, 7th edn
reliability_notes: General author and title reference; used as a cross-check on titles, dates and attributions throughout.

title: The Cambridge Companion to the Literature of the First World War (poetry and memoir chapters)
reliability_notes: Used specifically for the memoir and testimonial literature of 1928–37.

title: Modernism: A Guide to European Literature 1890–1930
reliability_notes: The standard critical guide to European modernism; used for movement definitions in the British and American context.

title: The Cambridge Companion to the Modernist Novel
reliability_notes: Used for the novel of consciousness, the experimental novel and the dating of the modernist long fiction.

title: The Oxford Handbook of Modernisms
author_or_editor: Peter Brooker, Andrzej Gasiorek, Deborah Longworth and Andrew Thacker (eds.)
reliability_notes: Used for the little-magazine movement and for the institutional history of modernism.

title: The Cambridge Companion to British Literature of the 1930s
reliability_notes: Used for the Auden generation, the documentary movement and the thirties writers.

title: The Oxford Companion to Crime and Mystery Writing
reliability_notes: Standard reference for the Golden Age detective novel and its authors.

title: The Penguin Classics editions of the individual novels and poems cited
reliability_notes: Textual authority for the works recorded here where a standard teaching edition exists; individual edition records are in work_editions.

title: The Waste Land: A Facsimile and Transcript of the Original Drafts
reliability_notes: The primary document for the composition and Pound's editing of The Waste Land; used for the dating and the composition history.

title: The Collected Poems of Wilfred Owen
reliability_notes: Standard edition of Owen's poems, including the fragments and the drafts; used for dating the war poems.

title: The Complete Poems of D. H. Lawrence
author_or_editor: D. H. Lawrence; Vivian de Sola Pinto and F. Warren Roberts (eds.)
reliability_notes: Standard edition of Lawrence's poems; used for the dating of the verse.

title: The Collected Letters of Joseph Conrad
author_or_editor: Joseph Conrad; Frederick R. Karl and Laurence Davies (eds.)
reliability_notes: The standard edition of Conrad's correspondence; used for composition dates and the dating of publication.

title: The Letters of Virginia Woolf
author_or_editor: Virginia Woolf; Nigel Nicolson and Joanne Trautmann (eds.)
reliability_notes: Standard edition of Woolf's letters; used for the Hogarth Press history and the dating of the novels.

title: The Collected Poems of W. B. Yeats
author_or_editor: W. B. Yeats; Richard J. Finneran (ed.)
reliability_notes: Standard one-volume edition of Yeats's poems; used for the dating of first publication.

title: The Collected Poems of Wallace Stevens
reliability_notes: The author's collected poems; used for the dating of first publication.

title: The Poems of Robert Frost
reliability_notes: The collected poems authorised in Frost's lifetime; used for the dating of first publication.

title: The Collected Poems of Langston Hughes
author_or_editor: Langston Hughes; Arnold Rampersad and David Roessel (eds.)
reliability_notes: The standard edition of Hughes's poems; used for the dating of the Harlem Renaissance verse.

title: The Complete Poems of Hart Crane
reliability_notes: The standard edition of Crane's poems; used for the dating of The Bridge.

title: The Poems of Edward Thomas
reliability_notes: Standard edition of Thomas's poems; used for the dating of the poems written in 1914–17.

title: The Collected Poems of Isaac Rosenberg
author_or_editor: Isaac Rosenberg; Gordon Bottomley and Denys Harding (eds.)
reliability_notes: Standard edition of Rosenberg's poems; used for the dating of the war poems.

title: The Collected Poems of Rupert Brooke
reliability_notes: The first posthumous collected edition (1915) established the canon of Brooke's war poems.

title: The Complete Poems of D. H. Lawrence (Cambridge edition)
reliability_notes: The scholarly edition of Lawrence's poems; used to confirm first-publication dates.

title: Ulysses: A Critical and Synoptic Edition
reliability_notes: The scholarly edition of Ulysses; used for the dating of serial and book publication.

title: The Letters of T. S. Eliot, Volume 1: 1898–1922
author_or_editor: T. S. Eliot; Valerie Eliot and Hugh Haughton (eds.)
reliability_notes: Used for the dating of Eliot's early poems and for the Criterion's founding.

title: The Diary of Virginia Woolf
reliability_notes: Used for the composition dates of the novels and for the Bloomsbury chronology.

title: The Autobiography of W. B. Yeats
reliability_notes: Yeats's own retrospective account of the revival; used with caution for the movement's chronology.
